# Public Digital - Radical Digital Transformation

## Supporting organisations through radical transformation

## What we do

We are a transformation consultancy that works with leading commercial organisations, governments and global institutions, helping them to change their ways of working to become more responsive, adaptable and impactful.

Tell us about your organisation’s context and challenges

## Client stories

### Helping IBCA deliver a trauma-informed service at pace

### A service-led approach to improving customer outcomes, productivity, and team alignment

### Delivering the UK Government’s Test, Learn and Grow programme

### Cyber Incident Grab Bag for Local Authorities

Thomas Duecke, COO, Digital at BT Group

> We’ve learned a lot from each other and Public Digital about how to boost our output, reduce our costs and improve our delivery predictability.

## Out now: The Intelligence Era Organisation

**Creating the Conditions to Thrive in the Age of AI**

Our new book focuses on helping leaders to navigate organisational change in the age of AI. Using examples from government and industry, it explores why so many transformation programmes fail and sets out the conditions organisations need to create to thrive in the AI era.

## Latest updates

### Our latest podcast episode: How to thrive in the age of AI

### Digital Sovereignty: The Power to Decide

Digital Sovereignty: The Power to Decide - a new book authored by PD to be published in September 2026.

### Updating my definition of digital

## Thought Leadership

### Book: The Intelligence Era Organisation

Author Adam Maddison explores how senior leaders can get real results from AI investment, instead of treating it as a quick fix.

### Book: Shaping technology for transformation

This collection of articles offers a guide to paying down technical debt and building technological strength.

### Book: Adopting the practice of Test and Learn

This book authored by Public Digital colleagues, unpacks what we mean by test and learn and how it can be applied to reforming services.

# Public Digital - 徹底的數位轉型

## 協助組織推動根本性的轉型

## 我們的工作

我們是一家轉型顧問公司，與領先企業、政府和全球性機構合作，協助它們改變工作方式，變得更能即時回應、更具適應力，也更能創造影響。

告訴我們你們組織的脈絡與挑戰

## 客戶案例

### 協助 IBCA 快速交付具創傷知情取向的服務

### 以服務為導向，改善客戶成果、生產力與團隊協作

### 交付英國政府的 Test, Learn and Grow 計畫

### 地方政府的網路事件應變工具包

Thomas Duecke，BT Group 數位部門營運長

> 我們從彼此和 Public Digital 身上學到很多，知道如何提升產出、降低成本，並改善交付的可預測性。

## 現已推出：《The Intelligence Era Organisation》

**打造在 AI 時代蓬勃發展的條件**

我們的新書聚焦於協助領導者面對 AI 時代的組織變革。書中透過政府與產業案例，探討為什麼這麼多轉型計畫會失敗，並提出組織若要在 AI 時代蓬勃發展，需要創造哪些條件。

## 最新消息

### 最新一集 podcast：如何在 AI 時代蓬勃發展

### 數位主權：決定的權力

《數位主權：決定的權力》是一本由 PD 撰寫的新書，預計於 2026 年 9 月出版。

### 更新我對數位的定義

## 思想領導

### 書籍：《The Intelligence Era Organisation》

作者 Adam Maddison 探討高階領導者如何從 AI 投資中取得真正成果，而不是把 AI 視為快速解方。

### 書籍：《Shaping technology for transformation》

這本文集提供一份指南，說明如何償還技術債，並建立技術實力。

### 書籍：《Adopting the practice of Test and Learn》

這本由 Public Digital 同事撰寫的書，拆解我們所說的「test and learn」是什麼，以及它如何應用於服務改革。
